text:
Maya: cleo discovered my ukulele and now interprets sunlight as showtime. photo: https://img.internal/cleo-ukulele-balcony.jpg :ukulele: :cat: 
Evan: that is a very indie balcony performance. does she accept tips in catnip? :tipping_hand_woman: 
Priya: bonus: the tiny paw on the string is peak drama. 10/10 would buy tickets. 
Maya: she insists on a single spotlight (the watering can) and a strict setlist of purrs. 
Evan: GIF request: tiny paw strum in slo-mo. 
Maya: GIF: https://img.internal/cleo-strum.gif, includes dramatic eyebrow raise. 
ops-bot: Reminder: please keep instruments secure when leaving desks unattended and register acoustic pets for office acoustic planning. :musical_note: 
Priya: vote: name for the monthly watercooler talent show? Options: "Balcony Bops" / "Pets & Props" / "Open Paws". 
Evan: voted Balcony Bops. 
Maya: voted Pets & Props. 
Priya: voted Open Paws. 
Maya: final: Cleo would like avocado toast and a soft blanket as rider accommodations. demands are negotiable with chin rubs. :avocado: :blanket_folded:
